cohort: 752 preschool children aged 2-6 years attending municipal daycare centers in Taubaté, São Paulo, Brazil
finding: Birth by cesarean delivery was associated with a higher median zBMI and an increased prevalence of overweight in preschool children.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was found to be associated with an increased risk of overweight in preschoolers, even after adjusting for other potential risk factors.
birth_weight: Measured, but specific values not reported
